benchmark_assessment.coal: The erroneous full-envelope export-and-replacement behavior is removed: the candidate uses domestic coal domestically in both 2022 and 2023. Actual simultaneous coal imports and exports remain unrepresented because the case has one homogeneous coal commodity and no grade or plant-compatibility distinction.
benchmark_assessment.oil: The candidate uses Galoc extraction domestically in 2022 and chooses no crude exports. It also leaves the 2020 oil extraction envelope unused because domestic extraction is then uneconomic. Actual Galoc exports cannot coexist economically with higher-cost imported crude in the aggregated one-crude-pool topology.
benchmark_assessment.interpretation: The price correction fixes the artificial arbitrage without forcing trade outcomes. Zero modeled exports and zero 2020 oil extraction are disclosed benchmark gaps requiring grade/location/refinery differentiation if future fidelity is needed.
